_comment: Curated reference rotations (P12). Hand-authored from canonical guide rotations (Prydwen) cross-checked against kit mechanics, then validated against validateRotation (zero warnings). Each doubles as the weight anchor AND the empty-build default suggestion. Keyed by resonator id (string). Echo Skill step = '__echo__'. Buff-only / no-self-damage steps (Outro, Dodge/Dash) are omitted: they deal no damage to the resonator herself and their team buffs are modeled by off-field / team-sim, not the solo anchor. Order is normalized where a guide's quickswap/animation-cancel notation can't be expressed as discrete steps — this preserves the damage-by-type proportion (what drives the weights) without claiming frame-exact sequencing. This file is curated input (like patch.json) — safe to hand-edit; it is NOT generated.

1205.source: Prydwen standard rotation, order-normalized to True Sight gate (capture→conquest→charge); verified by maintainer 2026-06-27
